result.instructions: Tools for Splose, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments does the clinic have tomorrow, and with whom?"; "Which invoices are still awaiting payment, oldest first?"; "Find the next free slot this week for an initial assessment with Dr Smith.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Splose data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run splose_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run splose_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run splose_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. splose_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: splose_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: WRITE: books ONE appointment for one patient with one practitioner, service and location, from start to end (UTC). Splose may send the patient its normal booking confirmation or reminders according to the practice's settings, and the appointment can later be invoiced. Check splose_find_free_slots first. Not idempotent: calling twice books twice. POST /appointments.

tools.name: splose_update_appointment
tools.title: Update (reschedule) an appointment
tools.description: WRITE: changes the time, service, location, practitioner, case or patient of ONE existing appointment; send only the fields to change. Splose may notify the patient of a change according to the practice's settings. Same input twice gives the same result. PUT /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: splose_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: WRITE: cancels ONE appointment with a cancellation reason (ids from splose_list_cancellation_reasons) and an optional note. The reason's billable rate may create a cancellation charge, and the patient may be notified per the practice's settings. For a group appointment pass patient_id to cancel only that patient's place; without it the whole appointment is cancelled. Cannot be undone through this server: confirm with the user first and pass confirm: true. POST /appointments/{id}/cancellation or /appointments/{id}/patients/{patientId}/cancellation.

patient_id.description: Group appointments only: cancel just this patient's participation.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has confirmed this cancellation (it may charge a fee and notify the patient).

tools.name: splose_mark_patient_arrived
tools.title: Mark a patient as arrived
tools.description: WRITE: marks the patient of ONE appointment as arrived (check-in). For a group appointment pass patient_id to mark just that patient. Marking twice has the same effect. POST /appointments/{id}/arrival or /appointments/{id}/patients/{patientId}/arrival.

patient_id.description: Group appointments only: the patient who arrived.

tools.name: splose_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE new patient record (first and last name required). Search with splose_list_patients first to avoid a duplicate. Patient messaging follows the practice's settings and communicationPreference. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two patients. HEALTH DATA: only enter what the user supplied. POST /patients.

alert.description: Alert message shown on the patient record.

invoiceRecipientId.description: Contact id that receives the invoices.

tools.name: splose_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE contact (GP, plan manager, referrer, payer). type, name and email are required (type is Splose's contact type, e.g. Standard; see splose_list_contacts for the values in use). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two contacts. POST /contacts.

type.description: Contact type, e.g. Standard (copy the value from an existing contact).

name.description: Display name, e.g. a plan manager's business name.

tools.name: splose_record_payment
tools.title: Record a payment against an invoice
tools.description: WRITE, MONEY: records ONE payment received (cash, card, transfer) against ONE invoice; it moves the invoice towards Paid and is shown in the patient's account. It does NOT charge anyone's card. amount must not exceed what is owed (check splose_get_invoice). Not idempotent: calling twice records two payments, and this server cannot delete a payment, so confirm the details with the user first and pass confirm: true. Ids come from splose_get_invoice and splose_list_payment_methods. POST /payments.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has confirmed the invoice, amount and payment method.

annotations.title: Record a payment against an invoice
